actors: FP32 deterministic eval no grad; TF32 off
known_limit: D02 maps are reused public development data
node: first eligible Goal call in inclusive window, original UID order, legal count >= 2

randomness.map_and_env_rng: original worker root and JAX split
randomness.repeats: separate Actor sampling streams only; environment/opponent initialization reused

sampling: original Bernoulli and categorical probabilities; hashed indexed inverse CDF
sham: first two registered maps, both sides, same A/repeat0 twice; at least one verified pair per side
sham_failure: stop before formal branches; no substitutions

statistic.missing: retain in denominators, zero sign-product contribution, no synthetic deltas

stops: prefix, mask, state, RNG, worker or journal mismatch; failure retained, no automatic retry
window_assignment: D02 original map_rank modulo 3, same window for both sides
